config.intervals: 95% percentile cluster bootstrap; no label stratification; row-weighted estimand
config.grouping: Connected components of exact code hash, nonempty source commit URL, valid CVE, and supplied CWEval family. Project sensitivity additionally links project names.
config.threshold_policy: Fixed grid and all distinct score boundaries; test-set exploratory upper bound only; no threshold adopted.
config.calibration: 10 equal-width probability bins; 10 quantile bins as sensitivity; no calibrator fitted.
config.average_precision: Non-interpolated sum of recall increments times precision (sklearn average_precision_score).
